description.p: Cero is a high-performance AI-native Linux terminal emulator featuring embedded llama-server orchestration, deterministic multi-stage workflow replay, autonomous terminal actions with shadow PTY simulation, and native system diagnostics.

ul.li: Embedded local model inference engine (GGUF / llama-server)
Autonomous command synthesis and safe AST validation
Native Linux desktop integration with system metrics telemetry

description.p: Cero 2.0.0 Linux production release with multi-distribution packaging.
